entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave The Bahamas.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses después de la fecha en que planeas salir de Bahamas.
entry.quote: To enter The Bahamas, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave.

entry.en: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Necesitas un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas de un país considerado de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter The Bahamas, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Importing or possessing a firearm or ammunition without appropriate permission is illegal.
entry.es: Importar o poseer un arma de fuego o munición sin el permiso adecuado es ilegal.
entry.quote: It is illegal to import a firearm or ammunition into the Bahamas or to possess a firearm in the country without appropriate permission.

entry.en: Visitors do not need to complete the customs form.
entry.es: Los visitantes no necesitan rellenar el formulario de aduanas.
entry.quote: Visitors do not need to complete the customs form.

safety.en: There have been violent crimes and armed robberies, sometimes fatal, in residential and tourist areas of New Providence and Grand Bahama.
safety.es: Ha habido delitos violentos y robos a mano armada, a veces mortales, en zonas residenciales y turísticas de New Providence y Gran Bahama.
safety.quote: There have been violent crimes and armed robberies, sometimes fatal, in residential and tourist areas of New Providence and Grand Bahama.

safety.en: Do not go on foot outside the main tourist areas and beaches, especially if you are alone.
safety.es: No andes a pie fuera de las principales zonas turísticas y playas, sobre todo si estás solo.
safety.quote: To reduce your risk, do not go on foot outside the main tourist areas and beaches, especially if you are alone.

safety.en: Fatal shark attacks can happen without warning, and night swimming raises the risk even in shallow water near resorts.
safety.es: Los ataques mortales de tiburón pueden ocurrir sin aviso y nadar de noche aumenta el riesgo incluso en aguas poco profundas cerca de resorts.
safety.quote: Fatal shark attacks can happen without warning. Night swimming (including at dusk), puts you at a higher risk, even in shallow waters close to resorts.

safety.en: The water sports industry is poorly regulated, so be careful renting jet skis and other equipment.
safety.es: El sector de deportes acuáticos está mal regulado, así que ten cuidado al alquilar motos de agua y otros equipos.
safety.quote: The water sports industry in The Bahamas is poorly regulated. Be careful when renting jet skis and other water sports equipment, as many companies and individuals offering water sports activities are unregistered or use poor quality equipment.

safety.en: The hurricane season normally runs from 1 June to 30 November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes normalmente va del 1 de junio al 30 de noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season in The Bahamas normally runs from 1 June to 30 November.

safety.en: Penalties for possessing or trafficking drugs are severe.
safety.es: Las penas por posesión o tráfico de drogas son severas.
safety.quote: Penalties for possessing or trafficking drugs are severe.

health.en: Call 911 or 919 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Llama al 911 o al 919 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 911 or 919 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Medical treatment is of a good standard but can be expensive, and emergency facilities are limited on the Family Islands.
health.es: La atención médica es de buen nivel pero puede ser cara, y las instalaciones de urgencia son limitadas en las islas del interior.
health.quote: Medical treatment is of a good standard but can be expensive. Emergency medical facilities are limited on all the Family Islands.

health.en: Tap water is generally potable, but bottled water is recommended for visitors.
health.es: El agua del grifo suele ser potable, pero se recomienda agua embotellada a los visitantes.
health.quote: Tap water is generally potable, but bottled water is recommended for visitors.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911 or 919.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911 o el 919.

getting_in.en: The largest airports are at Nassau on New Providence and Freeport on Grand Bahama.
getting_in.es: Los mayores aeropuertos están en Nassau, en New Providence, y en Freeport, en Gran Bahama.
getting_in.quote: The largest airports in the Bahamas are at the capital Nassau, on New Providence, and Freeport, on Grand Bahama.

getting_in.en: The Bahamas has six international airports, the largest being Lynden Pindling International Airport in Nassau.
getting_in.es: Bahamas tiene seis aeropuertos internacionales, el mayor el Aeropuerto Internacional Lynden Pindling, en Nassau.
getting_in.quote: The Bahamas has six international airports the largest being the Lynden Pindling International Airport on the west side of Nassau.

getting_in.en: A passenger ferry runs daily between Fort Lauderdale and Freeport or Bimini.
getting_in.es: Un ferry de pasajeros opera a diario entre Fort Lauderdale y Freeport o Bimini.
getting_in.quote: A regular passenger ferry operated by Baleària Caribbean runs daily between Fort Lauderdale, Florida and Freeport or Bimini in the Bahamas

getting_in.en: Nassau is one of the world's busiest cruise ship ports.
getting_in.es: Nassau es uno de los puertos de cruceros más concurridos del mundo.
getting_in.quote: The capital, Nassau, on New Providence Island is one of the world's busiest cruise ship ports, and is well served by ships that originate from Florida.

getting_around.en: Bahamasair covers most population centers from Nassau but is described as expensive, infrequent and notorious for delays.
getting_around.es: Bahamasair cubre la mayoría de núcleos desde Nassau, pero se describe como cara, poco frecuente y famosa por sus retrasos.
getting_around.quote: Bahamasair offers a comprehensive network radiating out from Nassau and covering most population centers. However, fares are expensive, frequencies are low, planes are small and the airline is notorious for extensive delays

getting_around.en: Nassau and New Providence have buses called jitneys.
getting_around.es: Nassau y New Providence tienen autobuses llamados jitneys.
getting_around.quote: Nassau/New Providence have a system of buses called jitneys, discussed in the Nassau article.

getting_around.en: Mail boats serve almost all populated islands and are among the cheapest options, but many passengers find them slow and uncomfortable.
getting_around.es: Los barcos de correo sirven casi todas las islas pobladas y son de lo más barato, pero muchos pasajeros los consideran lentos e incómodos.
getting_around.quote: Mail boats serve almost all populated islands in the Bahamas, and are amongst the cheapest way to reach many areas, though be warned that many passengers find them slow and not very comfortable.

getting_around.en: Bahamas Ferries is known as a bit more expensive but much more reliable than mail boats.
getting_around.es: Bahamas Ferries tiene fama de ser algo más cara pero mucho más fiable que los barcos de correo.
getting_around.quote: Bahamas Ferries runs between several of the major islands. It's known for being a bit more expensive but much more reliable than mail boats.

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left, but most vehicles, including hire cars, are left-hand drive imports from the USA.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por la izquierda, pero la mayoría de vehículos, incluidos los de alquiler, son importados de EE. UU. con volante a la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Although traffic drives on the left-hand side of the road, most vehicles, including hire cars, are imported from the USA and are left-hand drive.

money.en: The Bahamian dollar is pegged 1:1 to the US dollar and US dollars are accepted everywhere at par.
money.es: El dólar bahameño está ligado 1:1 al dólar estadounidense y este se acepta en todas partes a la par.
money.quote: The local currency is the Bahamian dollar (B$, BSD), but it is tied to the US dollar at a 1:1 ratio and US dollars are accepted everywhere at par.

money.en: Salespeople in the straw market negotiate prices in a very direct but often humorous manner.
money.es: Los vendedores del mercado de paja negocian los precios de forma muy directa pero a menudo humorística.
money.quote: Salespeople in the straw market have a very direct but often humorous manner of negotiating the price of a product.

money.en: The vast majority of "Cubans" sold in the Bahamas are counterfeit.
money.es: La gran mayoría de los supuestos puros cubanos que se venden en Bahamas son falsos.
money.quote: The vast majority of "Cubans" for sale in the Bahamas are counterfeit

etiquette.en: Bahamians are good-natured but do not suffer fools gladly.
etiquette.es: Los bahameños son de buen carácter pero no toleran a los tontos.
etiquette.quote: Bahamians are good-natured but do not suffer fools gladly.
